'''Slagworks''' were the mining facilities in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], a city on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were composed of several [[Mining/Legends|mine shafts]] descending into the promontory, and a smelting facility.

Three [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] overseers supervised about twenty-five workers of various species.
